assessments.reasoning: The pinned json/details/AFL-2.1.json gives AFL-2.1, Academic Free License v2.1 and isDeprecatedLicenseId=false. Its crossRef and seeAlso list linux-mirror’s afl-2.1.txt, its 20061013013632 archive and the pinned D-Bus COPYING#L11-207.
The upstream unsigned v3.29.0 annotated tag targets an object of type commit with SHA 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. AFL-2.1.json was inspected at that revision.
OSI’s archived v2.1 body gives the edition notice and links afl-2.1.txt as the plain-text version. The previous-version links to 2.0, 1.2 and 1.1 occur outside the grant.

The raw D-Bus COPYING at 789d97ad53044f94351a958e785c2923643b346a contains the cited AFL v2.1 heading and notice. Its preamble offers AFL 2.1 or GPL 2 or later and expressly identifies GPL-only exceptions, bounding what the specimen can establish.

challenge.method: Checked the release target and all three cross-references. Compared the raw project file at the referenced commit with the OSI notice, including the GPL material, post-license v1.0 commentary and SPDX’s D-Bus match field.
challenge.results: The cited AFL passage identifies v2.1 before the commentary and GPL text. SPDX records the D-Bus match as “false”, which precludes treating its link as a verified text match. The edition notice still agrees, including the matching 52-byte notice digests in the OSI and D-Bus captures.

limitations: D-Bus’s choice of licenses, its GPL-only exceptions and its file-level notices have project-specific scope. They establish neither general AFL/GPL compatibility nor applicability to every file.
The project copy and mirror routes share license-text lineage. Neither the references nor the excerpt digests establish equality of entire legal bodies or historical OSI approval.
reasoning: The release detail assigns AFL-2.1 to Academic Free License v2.1. OSI’s grant and the specific D-Bus COPYING passage both name v2.1. The project copy supplies direct context for one of the detail’s references.
